results.description:
Jake vowed never to let love interfere with chasing his rodeo dreams.

Then Beth's truck breaks down, leaving her stranded on the rodeo circuit—and suddenly protecting his heart is harder than staying on a bucking bronc.

Jake Callahan has one goal: win enough buckles to prove sacrificing everything for the rodeo wasn't a mistake. After tragedy shattered the future he'd imagined, chasing championships feels a whole lot safer than risking his heart again.

Beth Rose has one last summer to chase the rodeo dream she's held onto for years before returning to college to build the future she's carefully planned. When her truck breaks down, sharing Jake's trailer is the only way to stay on the circuit. The last thing she needs is to fall for a cowboy whose heart already belongs to the rodeo.

As miles on the road turn strangers into friends, playful banter gives way to unexpected feelings, and two wounded hearts begin to discover that sometimes God has plans bigger than the dreams they've been chasing.

Falling for the Bronc Rider is the first novel in the Faithful Cowboys series—a heartfelt Christian cowboy romance filled with authentic faith, unforgettable characters, slow-burn chemistry, laugh-out-loud banter, and the kind of hope that stays with you long after you've turned the final page.
